content.content: Only creation, recording, and removal invocations bracket. Undo and redo invocations never bracket: no marker exists for an undo, so an undo cannot be undone — repeat undo steps one operation further back. Non-mutating invocations are not operations and never bracket.
content.rationale: Bracketing marks mutating work for later undo; undo and redo are reverts, not work, so bracketing them would manufacture undoable units out of reverts. This answers the question G-operation leaves open, in the table it names; undo and redo behave as jj's do, stepping to a prior state without creating a new undoable unit.
